answer: Take one submission. A peer chosen at random re-executes it and compares the output hash. If the hash differs, payment is clawed back and the bond takes the loss. A replay of an old answer trips the same check, because the receipt carries a fresh nonce for each epoch. Quorum must span unrelated subnetworks, so a hollow ring of friends cannot clear itself. The vault opens only when strangers agree, and that agreement is what a farm cannot buy cheaply. Each cleared case carries a saffron mark any peer can audit later.
